feats.title: Arcane Prodigy
feats.description: Once per encounter as a free action, you can gain a +2 bonus to your next damage roll. The bonus increases to +3 at 11th level and +4 at 21st level. In addition, you can wield sorcerer implements.

feats.title: Soul of Sorcery
feats.description: Choose acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant, or thunder. You gain resist 5 to that damage type. In addition, you can wield sorcerer implements.
